task_specification.objective: Ship a reachable Alpha combat slice with intact first-person hands, grounded rifle animation, and synchronized single-owner feedback while preserving the authored map, existing weapon packages, input/lifecycle behavior, blocked-shot receipts, UI scale, and clean boot.

diagnosis.root_cause: Integration ownership is inconsistent: heuristic map-anchor selection does not reliably commit a legal deployment-to-Alpha route; the live viewmodel and enemy adapters do not preserve intact hands, upright roots, and rifle-semantic animation; and mission feedback duplicates player footstep playback while route-blocked combat cannot complete one authoritative event-to-presentation chain.

stop_conditions: Do not move, hide, duplicate, extract, or edit authored map children, add proxy floors, or replace native streets; stop if legal anchors cannot be bound on the intact navigation surface.
Do not split, replace, or surgically edit the coupled weapon/hands source; stop if wrapper, instance, skeleton, animation, or visibility repair cannot restore both hands.
Do not map rifle fire/reload to pistol, spell, interaction, prone, or death clips.
Do not schedule deferred bomb-finale, shell/settings, CG, performance, or environment-density work.
Stop and repair any introduced boot, resource, script, input, collision, or duplicate-damage regression.

strategy.rationale: Use deterministic anchor binding, direct intact-instance restoration, actor/presentation responsibility separation, and explicit audio-owner isolation instead of repeating transform, threshold, or cadence tuning.

code: Require clean boot/import, valid resources/signals, zero candidate-script errors, one intact active viewmodel, yaw-only enemy roots, rifle-compatible aliases, and no mission-created player footstep emitter.
Recheck runtime errors after navigation, fire, impact, kill, reset, Replay, and cleanup callbacks; verify immutable shot/damage deduplication and compact trigger-release fields.
runtime: Tester recaptures a thawed ordinary-input sequence from fresh deployment through early/middle/late route samples, first visible enemy, legal Alpha overlap, combat, and capture. Bind route corners, player grounding/stalls, objective legality, enemy activation, and event IDs.

For all Alpha enemies, sample spawn, activation, movement/search, aim, fire, reload, hurt, death, F6, checkpoint, Replay, and fresh mission where reachable. Bind stable ID, full-capsule occupancy, floor/navigation support, root rotation, visible forward, weapon family, clip, velocity, spacing, muzzle occlusion, and authority.

Inspect every live footstep player during walk/sprint/crouch/land and enemy movement; require one owner per actor, decoded stream, correct bus/cadence/grounding, and cleanup. Exercise AUTO press/hold/release plus Home, Replay, and checkpoint without process restart.

Fire unobstructed no-spread shots at near/middle/long range and one blocked shot; compare reticle projection, aim/hit endpoints, tracer, impact, damage, HUD, shot ID, presentation latency, and duplicate count.
visual: Capture AK-74M hip, settled ADS, fire peak/recovery, and reload contact from the shipped camera; require both hands, credible muzzle/optic direction, stable contact, and no clipping or HUD obstruction.
Capture Alpha early/middle/contested views and one external diagnostic view; require separated bearings, upright grounded actors, readable rifle motion, and no stacking, wall embedding, or sliding.

Capture impact, damage, hit, kill, and capture feedback while active at 100-percent UI scale; compare with the bound tactical-industrial reference for cyan/amber hierarchy, restrained borderless HUD, readable reticle/objectives, and no opaque panels. Patrol preserved daylight/exposure and HUD scale for regression.

done_when: Fresh deployment commits one collision-backed spawn/Alpha pair with connected ordered corners, capsule clearance, valid first escape, and ordinary-input legal Alpha overlap within 30–45 seconds without reset or geometry bypass.

Three stable Alpha enemies activate before objective entry from separated route/cover slots; full capsules clear static geometry and actors, navigation remains grounded, and roots retain near-zero pitch/roll while world yaw follows movement/threat.

M4 aim, fire, and reload use credible rifle-compatible clips with stable weapon contact; reachable idle, detect, move, aim, fire, reload, hurt, and death states follow authoritative velocity, visibility, ammo, damage, and health.

The live AK-74M instance retains gun, both hands, skeleton, AnimationLibrary, clips, and sockets under one adapter; both hands visibly contact the weapon in hip, ADS, fire/recovery, and reload. Existing native victory-dance binding remains intact without adding a terminal shortcut.
